evidence.notAProductDefect: In the runs where the rest of the matrix executed, the same test file passes in the sibling slots: in 42957099225, slots 22, 24, 24.8.0 and 26 all pass cdp-recovery.test.ts while 22.22.3 fails it. Twelve runs on seven different heads hit the signature in five matrix slots across four test files; the wrapped form (an APP_NOT_OPEN assertion carrying the same message) is the same native refusal, not an init-order or popup assertion about product behavior. The runner classifies a settled clean refusal: effects not-dispatched and scope usable, so nothing was dispatched twice and no page state was published from it. Each matrix slot gets its own 4-vCPU runner and runs three browser workers plus their app processes; a native scope going unavailable under that per-slot starvation is a transport-contention shape, not a single-user product path. It is not reproducible outside the matrix load.

runs.head: 6c2540aa5

evidence.notAProductDefect: The attempt reports status timed-out, not an assertion or engine error: its steps passed one by one and one browser.evaluate hung until the 12 s test watchdog cancelled it at 11.7 s. The same test passes in the four sibling slots of 42957097387 (22, 22.22.3, 24 and 26) that ran web-native-primitives-contract.test.ts with the same build, so the code path is not failing deterministically. It is a wall-clock starvation shape on a loaded matrix runner; the product path does not run 15 browser workers on four cores.

entries.signature: source_core (macos-15) cancelled after 15m02s: The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts

runs.annotation: The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts

evidence.notAProductDefect: The job never reached checkout or tests; GitHub cancelled it while waiting for a hosted macOS arm64 runner and its annotation says the runner was never acquired. The ubuntu-24.04 twin of the same run passed. Nothing in the repository ran, so no repository state is implicated.

entries.automatedRetry: None in this mechanism: a slot that never started has no failed test file to rerun, and integration-core is not one of the jobs spec gate requires. Rerun the workflow when runner capacity is available; the cancellation is audited by the run record.
